Long technical manual

Section 1. The calibration procedure repeats for each channel, and the technician records the offset in the log book before moving on. Each channel is driven from a stable reference, allowed to settle for two minutes, and then sampled twenty times; the median is written into the calibration table and the spread is noted separately so a drifting channel can be recognised later. Marker-001.
